X3DAppearanceChildNode.info: Nodes of this type can be used as child nodes for Appearance.

X3DAppearanceNode.info: Base type for all Appearance nodes.

X3DArrayField.info: X3DArrayField is the abstract field type from which all field types that can contain multiple values are derived, implementing the X3DField interface. All fields derived from X3DArrayField have names beginning with MF (multiple-valued field). MF fields may zero or more values, each of which shall be of the type indicated by the corresponding SF field type. It is illegal for any MF field to mix values of different SF field types.

X3DBackgroundNode.info: Abstract type from which all backgrounds inherit, also defining a background binding stack.

X3DBindableNode.info: Bindable nodes implement the binding stack, so that only one of each node type is active at a given time.

X3DChaserNode.info: The X3DChaserNode abstract node type calculates the output on value_changed as a finite impulse response (FIR) based on the events received on set_destination field.

X3DChildNode.info: A node that implements X3DChildNode is one of the legal children for a X3DGroupingNode parent.

X3DColorNode.info: Base type for color specifications in X3D.

X3DComposableVolumeRenderStyleNode.info: The X3DComposableVolumeRenderStyleNode abstract node type is the base type for all node types that allow rendering styles to be sequentially composed together to form a single renderable output.

X3DComposedGeometryNode.info: Composed geometry nodes produce renderable geometry, can contain Color Coordinate Normal TextureCoordinate, and are contained by a Shape node.

X3DCoordinateNode.info: Base type for all coordinate node types in X3D.

X3DDamperNode.info: The X3DDamperNode abstract node type creates an IIR response that approaches the destination value according to the shape of the e-function only asymptotically but very quickly.

X3DDragSensorNode.info: Base type for all drag-style pointing device sensors.

X3DEnvironmentalSensorNode.info: Base type for the environmental sensor nodes ProximitySensor, TransformSensor and VisibilitySensor.

X3DEnvironmentTextureNode.info: Base type for all nodes that specify cubic environment map sources for texture images.

X3DField.info: X3DField is the abstract field type from which all single values field types are derived. All fields directly derived from X3DField have names beginning with SF (single-valued field). SF fields may only contain a single value of the type indicated by the name of the field type.

X3DFollowerNode.info: X3DFollowerNode is the abstract base class for all nodes in the Followers component.

X3DFontStyleNode.info: Base type for all font style nodes.

X3DGeometricPropertyNode.info: Base type for all geometric property node types.

X3DGeometryNode.info: Geometry nodes produce renderable geometry and are contained by a Shape node.

X3DGroupingNode.info: Grouping nodes can contain other nodes as children, thus making up the backbone of a scene graph.

X3DInfoNode.info: Base type for all nodes that contain only information without visual semantics.

X3DInterpolatorNode.info: Interpolator nodes are designed for linear keyframed animation. Interpolators are driven by an input key ranging [0..1] and produce corresponding piecewise-linear output functions.

X3DKeyDeviceSensorNode.info: Base type for all sensor node types that operate using key devices.

X3DLayerNode.info: The X3DLayerNode abstract node type is the base node type for layer nodes.

X3DLayoutNode.info: X3DLayoutNode is the base node type for layout nodes.

X3DLightNode.info: Light nodes provide illumination for rendering geometry in the scene. Implementing nodes must include a global field with type SFBool and accessType inputOutput.

X3DMaterialNode.info: Base type for all Material nodes.

X3DNBodyCollidableNode.info: The X3DNBodyCollidableNode abstract node type represents objects that act as the interface between the rigid body physics, collision geometry proxy, and renderable objects in the scene graph hierarchy.

X3DNBodyCollisionSpaceNode.info: The X3DNBodyCollisionSpaceNode abstract node type represents objects that act as a self-contained spatial collection of objects that can interact through collision detection routines.

X3DNetworkSensorNode.info: Base typefor all sensors that generate events based on network activity.

X3DNode.info: All instantiable nodes implement X3DNode, which corresponds to SFNode type in the X3D specification.

X3DNormalNode.info: Base type for all normal node types in X3D.

X3DNurbsControlCurveNode.info: Base type for all nodes that provide control curve information in 2D space.

X3DNurbsSurfaceGeometryNode.info: Abstract geometry type for all types of NURBS surfaces.

X3DOneSidedMaterialNode.info: Base type for material nodes that describe how the shape looks like from one side. A different number of contanied texture nodes are allowed by each of the implementing nodes.

X3DParametricGeometryNode.info: Base type for all geometry node types that are created parametrically and use control points to describe the final shape of the surface.

X3DParticleEmitterNode.info: The X3DParticleEmitterNode abstract type represents any node that is an emitter of particles.

X3DParticlePhysicsModelNode.info: The X3DParticlePhysicsModelNode abstract type represents any node that applies a form of constraints on the particles after they have been generated.

X3DPickSensorNode.info: The X3DPickSensorNode abstract node type is the base node type that represents the lowest common denominator of picking capabilities.

X3DPointingDeviceSensorNode.info: Base type for all pointing device sensors.

X3DProductStructureChildNode.info: Base type marking nodes that are valid product structure children for the CADGeometry component.

X3DPrototypeInstance.info: Base type for all prototype instances. Note that direct children nodes are disallowed, instead let fieldValue with type SFNode/MFNode contain them. Current practice is that, if desired, prototype authors must explicitly add the metadata SFNode field in the ProtoInterface.

X3DRigidJointNode.info: The X3DRigidJointNode abstract node type is the base type for all joint types.

X3DScriptNode.info: Base type for scripting nodes (but not shader nodes).

X3DSequencerNode.info: Base type from which all Sequencers are derived.

X3DShaderNode.info: Base type for all nodes that specify a programmable shader.

X3DShapeNode.info: Base type for all Shape nodes.

X3DSingleTextureCoordinateNode.info: Base type for all texture coordinate nodes which specify texture coordinates for a single texture.

X3DSingleTextureNode.info: Base type for all texture node types that define a single texture. A single texture can be used to influence a parameter of various material nodes in the Shape component, and it can be a child of MultiTexture.

X3DSingleTextureTransformNode.info: Base type for all texture transform nodes which specify texture coordinate transformation for a single texture.

X3DSoundChannelNode.info: Base type for all sound destination nodes, which represent the final destination of an audio signal and are what the user can ultimately hear.

X3DSoundDestinationNode.info: Base type for all sound destination nodes, which represent the final destination of an audio signal and are what the user can ultimately hear.

X3DSoundNode.info: Base type for all sound nodes.

X3DSoundProcessingNode.info: Base type for all sound processing nodes, which are used to enhance audio with filtering, delaying, changing gain, etc.

X3DSoundSourceNode.info: Nodes implementing X3DSoundSourceNode provide signal inputs to the audio graph.

X3DStatement.info: X3DStatement is a marker interface that identifies statements relating to nonrenderable scene graph structure. X3DStatement does not extend from any other node type since it is not an explicit part of the X3D node interface hierarchy, and DEF/USE is not appropriate for such statements.

X3DTexture2DNode.info: Base type for all nodes which specify 2D sources for texture images.

X3DTexture3DNode.info: Base type for all nodes that specify 3D sources for texture images.

X3DTextureCoordinateNode.info: Base type for all nodes which specify texture coordinates.

X3DTextureNode.info: Base type for all nodes which specify sources for texture images.

X3DTextureProjectorNode.info: Base type for all node types that specify texture projector nodes, which provide a form of lighting.

X3DTextureTransformNode.info: Base type for all nodes which specify a transformation of texture coordinates.

X3DTimeDependentNode.info: Base type from which all time-dependent nodes are derived.

X3DTouchSensorNode.info: Base type for all touch-style pointing device sensors.

X3DTriggerNode.info: Base type from which all trigger nodes are derived.

X3DVertexAttributeNode.info: Base type for all nodes that specify per-vertex attribute information to the shader.

X3DViewpointNode.info: Node type X3DViewpointNode defines a specific location in the local coordinate system from which the user may view the scene, and also defines a viewpoint binding stack.

X3DViewportNode.info: The X3DViewportNode abstract node type is the base node type for viewport nodes.

X3DVolumeDataNode.info: The X3DVolumeDataNode abstract node type is the base type for all node types that describe volumetric data to be rendered.

X3DVolumeRenderStyleNode.info: The X3DVolumeRenderStyleNode abstract node type is the base type for all node types that specify a specific visual rendering style to be used when rendering volume data.

X3DBoundedObject.info: X3DBoundedObject indicates that bounding box values can be provided (or computed) to encompass this node and any children.

X3DFogObject.info: Abstract type describing a node that influences the lighting equation through the use of fog semantics.

X3DMetadataObject.info: Each node inheriting the X3DMetadataObject interface contains a single array of strictly typed values: MFBool, MFInt32, MFFloat, MFDouble, MFString, or MFNode, the latter having children that are all Metadata nodes.

X3DPickableObject.info: The X3DPickableObject abstract interface marks a node as being capable of having customized picking performed on its contents or children.

X3DProgrammableShaderObject.info: Base type for all nodes that specify arbitrary fields for interfacing with per-object attribute values.

X3DUrlObject.info: X3DUrlObject indicates that a node has content loaded from a Uniform Resource Locator (URL) and can be tracked via a LoadSensor. Such child nodes have containerField='children' to indicate their relationship to the parent LoadSensor node.

AcousticProperties.info: AcousticProperties specifies the interaction of sound waves with characteristics of geometric objects in the scene.

absorption.desc: specifies the sound absorption coefficient of a surface, meaning the ratio of sound intensity not reflected by a surface.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the url asset.

diffuse.desc: diffuse coefficient of sound reflection indicates how much of the incident sound energy is reflected back in multiple directions.

refraction.desc: sound refraction coefficient of a medium, which determines change in propagation direction of sound wave when obliquely crossing boundary between two mediums where its speed is different.

specular.desc: specular coefficient of sound reflection striking a plane surface, directly reflected back into space, where angle of reflection equals angle of incidence.

Analyser.info: Analyser provides real-time frequency and time-domain analysis information, without any signal-processing change to the audio stream which is passed unprocessed from input to output.

channelCount.desc: channelCount reports number of channels provided by input nodes.

channelCountMode.desc: channelCountMode determines how individual channels are counted when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

channelInterpretation.desc: channelInterpretation determines how individual channels are treated when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

children.desc: The children field specifies audio-graph sound sources providing input signals for this node.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the url asset.

elapsedTime.desc: Current elapsed time since AudioClip activated/running, cumulative in seconds, and not counting any paused time.

fftSize.desc: fftSize represents size of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) used to determine frequency domain.

frequencyBinCount.desc: frequencyBinCount is half of fftSize and generally equates to number of data values available for the visualization.

gain.desc: The gain value only affects analysis, not output signal.

isActive.desc: isActive true/false events are sent when playback starts/stops.

isPaused.desc: isPaused true/false events are sent when AudioClip is paused/resumed.

maxDecibels.desc: maxDecibels represents maximum power value in scaling range for FFT analysis data.

minDecibels.desc: minDecibels represents minimum power value in scaling range for FFT analysis data.

pauseTime.desc: When time now >= pauseTime, isPaused becomes true and AudioClip becomes paused.

resumeTime.desc: When resumeTime becomes <= time now, isPaused becomes false and AudioClip becomes active.

smoothingTimeConstant.desc: smoothingTimeConstant represents averaging constant during last analysis frame.

startTime.desc: Absolute time: number of seconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT.

stopTime.desc: Absolute time: number of seconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT.

tailTime.desc: tailTime is duration of time that a node continues to provide output signal after the input signal becomes silent.

Anchor.info: Anchor is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

autoRefreshTimeLimit.desc: The [autoRefreshTimeLimit field has no effect, Anchor operation is only triggered by user selection.

parameter.desc: If provided, parameter tells the X3D player where to to redirect the loaded url.

url.desc: Address of replacement world, or #ViewpointDEFName within the current scene, or alternate Web resource, activated by the user selecting Shape geometry within the Anchor children nodes.

visible.desc: Whether or not renderable content within this node is visually displayed.

Appearance.info: Appearance specifies the visual properties of geometry by containing the Material, ImageTexture/MovieTexture/PixelTexture, FillProperties, LineProperties, programmable shader nodes (ComposedShader, PackagedShader, ProgramShader) and TextureTransform nodes.

acousticProperties.desc: Optional single contained acousticProperties node that can specify additional acoustic attributes applied to associated surface geometry.

alphaCutoff.desc: Threshold value used for pixel rendering either transparent or opaque, used when alphaMode="MASK".

alphaMode.desc: Provides options for control of alpha transparency handling for textures.

backMaterial.desc: Optional single contained Material, PhysicalMaterial or UnlitMaterial node that can specify visual attributes for lighting response (color types, transparency, etc.

fillProperties.desc: Optional single contained FillProperties node that can specify additional visual attributes applied to polygonal areas of corresponding geometry, on top of whatever other appearance is already defined.

lineProperties.desc: Optional single contained LineProperties node that can specify additional visual attributes applied to corresponding line geometry.

material.desc: Optional single contained Material, PhysicalMaterial, TwoSidedMaterial (deprecated), or UnlitMaterial node that can specify visual attributes for lighting response (color types, transparency, etc.

pointProperties.desc: Optional single contained PointProperties node that can specify additional visual attributes applied to corresponding point geometry.

shaders.desc: Zero or more contained programmable shader nodes (ComposedShader, PackagedShader, ProgramShader) that specify, in order of preference, author-programmed rendering characteristics.

texture.desc: Optional single contained texture node (ImageTexture, MovieTexture, PixelTexture, MultiTexture) that maps image(s) to surface geometry.

textureTransform.desc: Optional single contained TextureTransform node that defines 2D transformation applied to texture coordinates.

Arc2D.info: Arc2D is a line-based geometry node that defines a linear circular arc with center (0,0) in X-Y plane, with angles measured starting at positive x-axis and sweeping towards positive y-axis.

endAngle.desc: Arc extends from startAngle counterclockwise to endAngle, in radians.

radius.desc: circle radius, of which the arc is a portion.

startAngle.desc: Arc extends from startAngle counterclockwise to endAngle, in radians.

ArcClose2D.info: ArcClose2D is a polygonal geometry node that defines a linear circular arc, closed by PIE or CHORD line segments, with center (0,0) in X-Y plane, with angles measured starting at positive x-axis and sweeping towards positive y-axis.

closureType.desc: Defines whether pair of line segments connect to center (PIE), or single line-segment chord connects arc endpoints (CHORD).

endAngle.desc: Arc extends from startAngle counterclockwise to endAngle, in radians.

radius.desc: circle radius, of which the arc is a portion.

solid.desc: Setting solid true means draw only one side of polygons (backface culling on), setting solid false means draw both sides of polygons (backface culling off).

startAngle.desc: Arc extends from startAngle counterclockwise to endAngle, in radians.

AudioClip.info: AudioClip provides audio data used by parent Sound nodes.

autoRefresh.desc: autoRefresh defines interval in seconds before automatic reload of current url asset is performed.

autoRefreshTimeLimit.desc: autoRefreshTimeLimit defines maximum duration that automatic refresh activity can occur.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the url asset.

elapsedTime.desc: Current elapsed time since AudioClip activated/running, cumulative in seconds, and not counting any paused time.

gain.desc: The gain field is a factor that represents the amount of linear amplification to apply to the output of the node.

isActive.desc: isActive true/false events are sent when playback starts/stops.

isPaused.desc: isPaused true/false events are sent when AudioClip is paused/resumed.

load.desc: load=true means load immediately, load=false means defer loading or else unload a previously loaded asset.

loop.desc: Repeat indefinitely when loop=true, repeat only once when loop=false.

pauseTime.desc: When time now >= pauseTime, isPaused becomes true and AudioClip becomes paused.

pitch.desc: Multiplier for the rate at which sampled sound is played.

resumeTime.desc: When resumeTime becomes <= time now, isPaused becomes false and AudioClip becomes active.

stopTime.desc: Absolute time: number of seconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT.

AudioDestination.info: AudioDestination node represents the final audio destination and is what user ultimately hears, typically from the speakers of user device.

channelCount.desc: channelCount reports number of channels provided by input nodes.

channelCountMode.desc: channelCountMode determines how individual channels are counted when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

channelInterpretation.desc: channelInterpretation determines how individual channels are treated when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

children.desc: The children field specifies audio-graph sound sources providing input signals for this node.

mediaDeviceID.desc: mediaDeviceID field provides a unique identifier for the active device that corresponds to deviceId functionality defined in W3C Web Audio API.

Background.info: Background simulates ground and sky, using vertical arrays of wraparound color values.

backUrl.desc: Image background panorama between ground/sky backdrop and scene's geometry.

bindTime.desc: event sent when node becomes active/inactive.

bottomUrl.desc: Image background panorama between ground/sky backdrop and scene's geometry.

frontUrl.desc: Image background panorama between ground/sky backdrop and scene's geometry.

groundAngle.desc: The angle array values increase from 0.

groundColor.desc: Color of the ground at the various angles on the ground partial sphere.

isBound.desc: event true sent when node becomes active, event false sent when unbound by another node.

leftUrl.desc: Image background panorama between ground/sky backdrop and scene's geometry.

rightUrl.desc: Image background panorama between ground/sky backdrop and scene's geometry.

set_bind.desc: Input event set_bind=true makes this node active, input event set_bind=false makes this node inactive.

skyAngle.desc: The angle array values increase from 0.

skyColor.desc: Color of the sky at various angles on the sky sphere.

topUrl.desc: Image background panorama between ground/sky backdrop and scene's geometry.

transparency.desc: how "clear" the background is, allows underlying page to show through: 1.

BallJoint.info: BallJoint represents an unconstrained joint between two bodies that pivot about a common anchor point.

anchorPoint.desc: anchorPoint is joint center, specified in world coordinates.

body1.desc: The body1 and body2 fields indicate the two RigidBody nodes connected by this joint.

body1AnchorPoint.desc: body1AnchorPoint describes anchorPoint position relative to local coordinate reference frame.

body2.desc: The body1 and body2 fields indicate the two RigidBody nodes connected by this joint.

body2AnchorPoint.desc: body2AnchorPoint describes anchorPoint position relative to local coordinate reference frame.

forceOutput.desc: forceOutput controls which output fields are generated for the next frame.

Billboard.info: Billboard is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

axisOfRotation.desc: axisOfRotation direction is relative to local coordinate system.

bboxCenter.desc: Bounding box center accompanies bboxSize and provides an optional hint for bounding box position offset from origin of local coordinate system.

bboxDisplay.desc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

bboxSize.desc: Bounding box size is usually omitted, and can easily be calculated automatically by an X3D player at scene-loading time with minimal computational cost.

children.desc: Grouping nodes contain an ordered list of children nodes.

visible.desc: Whether or not renderable content within this node is visually displayed.

BiquadFilter.info: BiquadFilter node is an AudioNode processor implementing common low-order filters.

channelCountMode.desc: channelCountMode determines how individual channels are counted when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

channelInterpretation.desc: channelInterpretation determines how individual channels are treated when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

children.desc: The children field specifies audio-graph sound sources providing input signals for this node.

detune.desc: The detune field, measured in cents, modulates the speed at which the the audio stream is rendered.

frequency.desc: frequency at which the BiquadFilterNode operates, in Hz.

gain.desc: The gain field is a factor that represents the amount of linear amplification to apply to the output of the node.

stopTime.desc: Absolute time: number of seconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT.

tailTime.desc: tailTime is duration of time that a node continues to provide output signal after the input signal becomes silent.

type.desc: type selects which BiquadFilter algorithm is used.

BlendedVolumeStyle.info: BlendedVolumeStyle combines rendering of two voxel data sets into one by blending voxel values.

renderStyle.desc: Optional single contained X3DComposableVolumeRenderStyleNode node that defines specific rendering technique for data in the voxels field, and the result is blended with parent VolumeData or SegmentedVoliumeData node.

voxels.desc: Optional single contained X3DTexture3DNode (ComposedTexture3D, ImageTexture3D, PixelTexture3D) that provides second set of raw voxel information utilized by corresponding rendering styles.

weightFunction1.desc: specifies 2D textures used to determine weight values when weight function is set to TABLE.

weightFunction2.desc: specifies 2D textures used to determine weight values when weight function is set to TABLE.

weightTransferFunction1.desc: The weightTransferFunction1 and weightTransferFunction2 fields specify two-dimensional textures that are used to determine the weight values when the weight function is set to "TABLE".

weightTransferFunction2.desc: The weightTransferFunction1 and weightTransferFunction2 fields specify two-dimensional textures that are used to determine the weight values when the weight function is set to "TABLE".

BooleanFilter.info: BooleanFilter selectively passes true, false or negated events.

inputFalse.desc: inputFalse only passes a false value, which occurs when set_boolean is false.

inputNegate.desc: inputNegate is an output event that provides an opposite value by negating set_boolean input.

inputTrue.desc: inputTrue only passes a true value, which occurs when set_boolean input is true.

set_boolean.desc: set_boolean is the input value to be filtered.

BooleanSequencer.info: BooleanSequencer generates periodic discrete Boolean values.

key.desc: Definition values for linear-interpolation function input intervals, listed in non-decreasing order and corresponding to a value in the keyValue array.

keyValue.desc: Output values for linear sequencing, each corresponding to an input-fraction value in the key array.

next.desc: Send next output value in keyValue array, and reset internal fraction field to match corresponding value in key array.

previous.desc: Send previous output value in keyValue array, and reset internal fraction field to match corresponding value in key array.

set_fraction.desc: set_fraction selects input key for corresponding keyValue output.

value_changed.desc: Single intermittent output value determined by current key time and corresponding keyValue entry.

BooleanToggle.info: BooleanToggle maintains state and negates output when a true input is provided.

set_boolean.desc: If input event set_boolean is true, flip state by negating current value of the toggle field Hint: for logical consistency, input event set_boolean false has no effect (under review as part of Mantis issue 519).

toggle.desc: Persistent state value that gets toggled or reset.

BooleanTrigger.info: BooleanTrigger converts time events to boolean true events.

set_triggerTime.desc: set_triggerTime provides input time event, typical event sent is TouchSensor touchTime.

triggerTrue.desc: triggerTrue outputs a true value whenever a triggerTime event is received.

BoundaryEnhancementVolumeStyle.info: BoundaryEnhancementVolumeStyle provides boundary enhancement for the volume rendering style.

boundaryOpacity.desc: boundaryOpacity k_gs is the factored amount of the gradient enhancement to use.

opacityFactor.desc: opacityFactor k_ge is the power function to control the slope of the opacity curve to highlight the set of data.

retainedOpacity.desc: retainedOpacity k_gc is the amount of initial opacity to mix into the output.

BoundedPhysicsModel.info: BoundedPhysicsModel provides user-defined geometrical boundaries for particle motion.

geometry.desc: Optional single contained geometry node provides the geometry used for each particle when the parent ParticleSystem node has geometryType=GEOMETRY.

Box.info: Box is a geometry node specifying a rectangular cuboid.

size.desc: size x y z in meters.

solid.desc: Setting solid true means draw only one side of polygons (backface culling on), setting solid false means draw both sides of polygons (backface culling off).

order.desc: order defines the number of internal filters (larger means smoother response, longer delay).

set_destination.desc: set_destination resets destination value of this node.

set_value.desc: set_value resets current value of this node.

tau.desc: tau is the exponential-decay time constant for filter response in seconds.

value_changed.desc: Computed output value that approaches within tolerance of destination value, as determined by elapsed time, order and tau.

Text.info: Text is a 2D (flat) geometry node that can contain multiple lines of string values.

fontStyle.desc: The fontStyle field can contain a FontStyle or ScreenFontStyle node defining size, family, and style for presented text.

length.desc: Array of length values for each text string in the local coordinate system.

lineBounds.desc: Array of 2D bounding box values for each line of text in the local coordinate system.

maxExtent.desc: Limits/compresses all text strings if max string length is longer than maxExtent, as measured in local coordinate system.

origin.desc: origin of the text local coordinate system, in units of the coordinate system in which the Text node is embedded.

solid.desc: Setting solid true means draw only one side of polygons (backface culling on), setting solid false means draw both sides of polygons (backface culling off).

string.desc: Single or multiple string values to present as Text.

textBounds.desc: 2D bounding box value for all lines of text in the local coordinate system.

TextureBackground.info: TextureBackground simulates ground and sky, using vertical arrays of wraparound color values, TextureBackground can also provide backdrop texture images on all six sides.

backTexture.desc: Parent TextureBackground element can contain up to six image nodes (ImageTexture PixelTexture MovieTexture MultiTexture).

bindTime.desc: event sent when node becomes active/inactive.

bottomTexture.desc: Parent TextureBackground element can contain up to six image nodes (ImageTexture PixelTexture MovieTexture MultiTexture).

frontTexture.desc: Parent TextureBackground element can contain up to six image nodes (ImageTexture PixelTexture MovieTexture MultiTexture).

groundAngle.desc: The angle array values increase from 0.

groundColor.desc: Color of the ground at the various angles on the ground partial sphere.

isBound.desc: event true sent when node becomes active, event false sent when unbound by another node.

leftTexture.desc: Parent TextureBackground element can contain up to six image nodes (ImageTexture PixelTexture MovieTexture MultiTexture).

rightTexture.desc: Parent TextureBackground element can contain up to six image nodes (ImageTexture PixelTexture MovieTexture MultiTexture).

set_bind.desc: Input event set_bind=true makes this node active, input event set_bind=false makes this node inactive.

skyAngle.desc: The angle array values increase from 0.

skyColor.desc: Color of the sky at various angles on the sky sphere.

topTexture.desc: Parent TextureBackground element can contain up to six image nodes (ImageTexture PixelTexture MovieTexture MultiTexture).

transparency.desc: transparency applied to texture images, enabling an X3D scene to overlay an HTML page or desktop.

TextureCoordinate.info: TextureCoordinate specifies 2D (s,t) texture-coordinate points, used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map textures to vertices (and patches to NURBS surfaces).

mapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

point.desc: pairs of 2D (s,t) texture coordinates, either in range [0,1] or higher if repeating.

TextureCoordinate3D.info: TextureCoordinate3D specifies a set of 3D texture coordinates used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map 3D textures to vertices.

mapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

point.desc: triplets of 3D (s,t,r) texture coordinates, either in range [0,1] or higher if repeating.

TextureCoordinate4D.info: TextureCoordinate4D specifies a set of 4D (homogeneous 3D) texture coordinates used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map 3D textures to vertices.

mapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

point.desc: 4-tuple values of 4D texture coordinates, either in range [0,1] or higher if repeating.

TextureCoordinateGenerator.info: TextureCoordinateGenerator computes 2D (s,t) texture-coordinate points, used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map textures to vertices (and patches to NURBS surfaces).

mapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

mode.desc: parameter field defines the algorithm used to compute texture coordinates.

parameter.desc: parameter array contains scale and translation (x y z) values for Perlin NOISE mode, parameter[0] contains index of refraction for SPHERE-REFLECT mode, parameter[0] contains index of refraction and parameter[1 to 3] contains the eye point in local coordinates for SPHERE-REFLECT-LOCAL mode.

TextureProjector.info: TextureProjector is similar to a light that projects a texture into the scene, illuminating geometry that intersects the perspective projection volume.

ambientIntensity.desc: Brightness of ambient (nondirectional background) emission from the light.

aspectRatio.desc: aspectRatio is the ratio of width and height that is projected, reported as output event when contained image is loaded.

color.desc: color of light, applied to colors of objects.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the url asset.

farDistance.desc: maximum distance necessary for texture display, -1 if unconstrained.

fieldOfView.desc: Preferred minimum viewing angle for this projection in radians, providing minimum height or minimum width (whichever is smaller).

global.desc: Global texture projection illuminates all objects within their volume of influence.

intensity.desc: Brightness of direct emission from the light.

location.desc: Position of center of texture projection relative to local coordinate system.

nearDistance.desc: minimum distance necessary for texture display, -1 if unconstrained.

shadowIntensity.desc: shadowIntensity field defines how much light is obscured by shapes that cast shadows, ranging from 0 (light not obscured, no visible shadows) to 1 (light completely obscured, full-intensity shadows).

shadows.desc: shadows field indicates whether or not this light casts a shadow behind illuminated X3DShapeNode geometry.

texture.desc: Optional single contained texture node (ImageTexture, MovieTexture, PixelTexture, MultiTexture) that maps image(s) to surface geometry.

upVector.desc: upVector describes camera orientation by defining which direction is up.

TextureProjectorParallel.info: TextureProjectorParallel is similar to a light that projects a texture into the scene, illuminating geometry that intersects the parallel projection volume.

aspectRatio.desc: aspectRatio is the ratio of width and height that is projected, reported as output event when contained image is loaded.

fieldOfView.desc: Minimum and maximum extents of projection texture in units of local coordinate system.

global.desc: Global texture projection illuminates all objects within their volume of influence.

intensity.desc: Brightness of direct emission from the light.

location.desc: Position of center of texture projection relative to local coordinate system.

nearDistance.desc: minimum distance necessary for texture display, -1 if unconstrained.

shadows.desc: shadows field indicates whether or not this light casts a shadow behind illuminated X3DShapeNode geometry.

upVector.desc: upVector describes camera orientation by defining which direction is up.

TextureProperties.info: TextureProperties allows precise fine-grained control over application of image textures to geometry.

anisotropicDegree.desc: anisotropicDegree defines minimum degree of anisotropy to account for in texture filtering (1=no effect for symmetric filtering, otherwise provide higher value).

borderWidth.desc: borderWidth number of pixels for texture border.

boundaryModeR.desc: boundaryModeR describes handling of texture-coordinate boundaries.

boundaryModeS.desc: boundaryModeS describes handling of texture-coordinate boundaries.

boundaryModeT.desc: boundaryModeT describes handling of texture-coordinate boundaries.

generateMipMaps.desc: Determines whether MIPMAPs are generated for texture images.

magnificationFilter.desc: magnificationFilter indicates texture filter when image is smaller than screen space representation.

minificationFilter.desc: minificationFilter indicates texture filter when image is larger than screen space representation.

textureCompression.desc: textureCompression indicates compression algorithm selection mode.

texturePriority.desc: texturePriority defines relative priority for this texture when allocating texture memory, an important rendering resource in graphics-card hardware.

TextureTransform.info: TextureTransform shifts 2D texture coordinates for positioning, orienting and scaling image textures on geometry.

center.desc: center point in 2D (s,t) texture coordinates for rotation and scaling.

mapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

rotation.desc: Single rotation angle of texture about center (opposite effect appears on geometry).

scale.desc: Non-uniform planar scaling of texture about center (opposite effect appears on geometry).

translation.desc: Lateral/vertical shift in 2D (s,t) texture coordinates (opposite effect appears on geometry).

TextureTransform3D.info: TextureTransform3D applies a 3D transformation to texture coordinates.

center.desc: center point in 2D (s,t) texture coordinates for rotation and scaling.

mapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

rotation.desc: rotation angle of texture about center (opposite effect appears on geometry).

scale.desc: Non-uniform planar scaling of texture about center (opposite effect appears on geometry).

translation.desc: Lateral/vertical shift in 2D (s,t) texture coordinates (opposite effect appears on geometry).

TextureTransformMatrix3D.info: TextureTransformMatrix3D applies a 3D transformation to texture coordinates.

mapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

matrix.desc: matrix is a generalized, unfiltered 4x4 transformation matrix to modify texture (opposite effect appears on geometry).

TimeSensor.info: TimeSensor continuously generates events as time passes.

cycleInterval.desc: cycleInterval is loop duration in seconds.

cycleTime.desc: cycleTime sends a time outputOnly at startTime, and also at the beginning of each new cycle (useful for synchronization with other time-based objects).

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of this node.

elapsedTime.desc: Current elapsed time since TimeSensor activated/running, cumulative in seconds, and not counting any paused time.

fraction_changed.desc: fraction_changed continuously sends value in range [0,1] showing time progress in the current cycle.

isActive.desc: isActive true/false events are sent when TimeSensor starts/stops running.

isPaused.desc: isPaused true/false events are sent when TimeSensor is paused/resumed.

loop.desc: Repeat indefinitely when loop=true, repeat only once when loop=false.

pauseTime.desc: When time now >= pauseTime, isPaused becomes true and TimeSensor becomes paused.

resumeTime.desc: When resumeTime becomes <= time now, isPaused becomes false and TimeSensor becomes inactive.

startTime.desc: When time now >= startTime, isActive becomes true and TimeSensor becomes active.

stopTime.desc: When stopTime becomes <= time now, isActive becomes false and TimeSensor becomes inactive.

time.desc: Time continuously sends the absolute time (value 0.

TimeTrigger.info: TimeTrigger converts boolean true events to time events.

set_boolean.desc: If input event set_boolean is true, send output triggerTime event.

triggerTime.desc: triggerTime is output time event, sent when input event set_boolean is true.

ToneMappedVolumeStyle.info: ToneMappedVolumeStyle specifies that volumetric data is rendered with Gooch shading model of two-toned warm/cool coloring.

coolColor.desc: coolColor is used for surfaces facing away from the light direction.

surfaceNormals.desc: The surfaceNormals field contains a 3D texture with at least three component values.

warmColor.desc: warmColor is used for surfaces facing towards the light.

TouchSensor.info: TouchSensor tracks location and state of the pointing device, detecting when a user points at or selects (activates) geometry.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of this node.

hitNormal_changed.desc: When pointing device selects geometry, send event containing surface normal vector at the hitPoint.

hitPoint_changed.desc: When pointing device selects geometry, send event containing 3D point on surface of underlying geometry, as measured in reference frame for TouchSensor's local coordinate system.

hitTexCoord_changed.desc: When pointing device selects geometry, send event containing texture coordinates of surface at the hitPoint.

isActive.desc: Select geometry by activating the pointing device (for example, clicking the mouse) to generate isActive events.

isOver.desc: Hover over geometry by aiming the mouse (or pointing device) to generate isOver events.

touchTime.desc: Time event generated when sensor is touched by pointing device, and then deselected by the user.

Transform.info: Transform is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

bboxCenter.desc: Bounding box center accompanies bboxSize and provides an optional hint for bounding box position offset from origin of local coordinate system.

bboxDisplay.desc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

bboxSize.desc: Bounding box size is usually omitted, and can easily be calculated automatically by an X3D player at scene-loading time with minimal computational cost.

center.desc: Translation offset from origin of local coordinate system, applied prior to rotation or scaling.

children.desc: Grouping nodes contain an ordered list of children nodes.

rotation.desc: Orientation (axis, angle in radians) of children relative to local coordinate system.

scale.desc: Non-uniform x-y-z scale of child coordinate system, adjusted by center and scaleOrientation.

scaleOrientation.desc: Preliminary rotation of coordinate system before scaling (to allow scaling around arbitrary orientations).

translation.desc: Position (x, y, z in meters) of children relative to local coordinate system.

visible.desc: Whether or not renderable content within this node is visually displayed.

TransformSensor.info: TransformSensor generates output events when its targetObject enters, exits, and moves within a region in space (defined by a box).

center.desc: Translation offset from origin of local coordinate system.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the node.

enterTime.desc: Time event generated when targetObject enters the box region for sensor.

exitTime.desc: Time event generated when targetObject exits the box region for sensor.

isActive.desc: isActive true/false events are sent when triggering the sensor.

orientation_changed.desc: Sends rotation event relative to center whenever the target object is contained within the box region and results change.

position_changed.desc: Sends translation event relative to center whenever the target object is contained within the box region and results change.

size.desc: size of transformation-traccking box around center location, oriented within local transformation frame.

targetObject.desc: targetObject is the movable geometry represented by any valid X3DGroupingNode or X3DShapeNode which may enter or exit the box.

TransmitterPdu.info: TransmitterPdu is a networked Protocol Data Unit (PDU) information node that provides detailed information about a radio transmitter modeled in a simulation.

antennaPatternType.desc: Antenna shape pattern: 0 for omnidirectional, 1 for beam, 2 for spherical harmonic (deprecated), or optional higher value.

applicationID.desc: Each simulation application that can respond to simulation management PDUs needs to have a unique applicationID.

bboxDisplay.desc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

cryptoKeyID.desc: Nonzero value corresponding to the simulated cryptographic key.

cryptoSystem.desc: Indicates type of crypto system being used, even if the encryption equipment is not keyed.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the node.

entityID.desc: EntityID unique ID for entity within that application.

geoCoords.desc: Geographic location (specified in current geoSystem coordinates) for children geometry (specified in relative coordinate system, in meters).

geoSystem.desc: Identifies spatial reference frame: Geodetic (GD), Geocentric (GC), Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM).

isActive.desc: confirm whether there has been a recent network update.

isNetworkReader.desc: Whether networkMode='remote' (listen to network as copy of remote entity).

isNetworkWriter.desc: Whether networkMode='master' (output to network as master entity at writeInterval).

isRtpHeaderHeard.desc: Whether incoming DIS packets have an RTP header prepended.

isStandAlone.desc: Whether networkMode='local' (ignore network but still respond to local events).

modulationTypeDetail.desc: Integer enumeration containing detailed information depending on the major modulation type.

modulationTypeMajor.desc: Integer enumeration containing major classification of the modulation type.

modulationTypeSpreadSpectrum.desc: Indicates the spread spectrum technique or combination of spread spectrum techniques in use.

modulationTypeSystem.desc: Specifies radio system associated with this Transmitter PDU and used to interpret other fields whose values depend on a specific radio system.

multicastRelayHost.desc: Fallback server address if multicast not available locally.

multicastRelayPort.desc: Fallback server port if multicast not available locally.

networkMode.desc: Whether this entity is ignoring the network, sending DIS packets to the network, or receiving DIS packets from the network.

power.desc: Power that radio would be capable of outputting if on and transmitting, independent of actual transmit state of the radio.

radioEntityTypeCategory.desc: Integer enumeration containing EntityType of transmitter radio.

radioEntityTypeCountry.desc: Integer enumerations value for country to which the design of the entity or its design specification is attributed.

radioEntityTypeDomain.desc: Integer enumerations value for domain in which the entity operates: LAND, AIR, SURFACE, SUBSURFACE, SPACE or OTHER.

radioEntityTypeKind.desc: Integer enumerations value for whether entity is a PLATFORM, MUNITION, LIFE_FORM, ENVIRONMENTAL, CULTURAL_FEATURE, SUPPLY, RADIO, EXPENDABLE, SENSOR_EMITTER or OTHER.

radioEntityTypeNomenclature.desc: Integer enumerations value indicating nomenclature (name) for a particular emitter.

radioID.desc: Identifies a particular radio within a given entity.

readInterval.desc: Seconds between read updates, 0 means no reading.

rtpHeaderExpected.desc: Whether RTP headers are prepended to DIS PDUs.

siteID.desc: Simulation/exercise siteID of the participating LAN or organization.

transmitFrequencyBandwidth.desc: Bandwidth of the particular transmitter measured between the half-power (-3 dB) points (this value represents total bandwidth, not the deviation from the center frequency).

transmitState.desc: Specify radio transmission state where enumerations value 0 is for off, value 1 for powered but not transmitting, or value 1 is for powered and transmitting,.

visible.desc: Whether or not renderable content within this node is visually displayed.

whichGeometry.desc: Select geometry to render: -1 for no geometry, 0 for text trace, 1 for default geometry, (optional) higher values to render different states.

writeInterval.desc: Seconds between write updates, 0 means no writing (sending).

colorPerVertex.desc: Whether Color|ColorRGBA values are applied to each point vertex (true) or to each polygon face (false).

coord.desc: Optional single contained Coordinate or CoordinateDouble node that can specify a list of vertex values.

fanCount.desc: fanCount array provides number of vertices in each fan.

fogCoord.desc: Optional single contained FogCoordinate node that can specify depth parameters for fog in corresponding geometry.

solid.desc: Setting solid true means draw only one side of polygons (backface culling on), setting solid false means draw both sides of polygons (backface culling off).

TwoSidedMaterial.info: TwoSidedMaterial specifies surface rendering properties for associated geometry, for outer (front) and inner (back) sides of polygons.

ambientIntensity.desc: how much ambient omnidirectional light is reflected from all light sources.

backAmbientIntensity.desc: how much ambient omnidirectional light is reflected from all light sources.

backDiffuseColor.desc: how much direct, angle-dependent light is reflected from all light sources.

backEmissiveColor.desc: how much glowing light is emitted from this object.

backShininess.desc: Lower shininess values provide soft specular glows, while higher values result in sharper, smaller highlights.

backSpecularColor.desc: specular highlights are brightness reflections (example: shiny spots on an apple).

emissiveColor.desc: how much glowing light is emitted from this object.

separateBackColor.desc: separateBackColor determines whether separate Material values are used for back faces.

specularColor.desc: specular highlights are brightness reflections (example: shiny spots on an apple).

UniversalJoint.info: UniversalJoint is like a BallJoint that constrains an extra degree of rotational freedom.

anchorPoint.desc: anchorPoint is joint center, specified in world coordinates.

axis1.desc: axis1 defines axis vector of joint connection to body1.

axis2.desc: axis2 defines axis vector of joint connection to body2.

body1.desc: The body1 and body2 fields indicate the two RigidBody nodes connected by this joint.

body1AnchorPoint.desc: body1AnchorPoint describes anchorPoint position relative to local coordinate reference frame.

body1Axis.desc: body1Axis describes report the current location of the anchor point relative to the corresponding body.

body2.desc: The body1 and body2 fields indicate the two RigidBody nodes connected by this joint.

body2AnchorPoint.desc: body2AnchorPoint describes anchorPoint position relative to local coordinate reference frame.

body2Axis.desc: body1Axis describes report the current location of the anchor point relative to the corresponding body.

forceOutput.desc: forceOutput controls which output fields are generated for the next frame.

stop1Bounce.desc: stop1Bounce is velocity factor for bounce back once stop point is reached.

stop1ErrorCorrection.desc: stop1ErrorCorrection is fraction of error correction performed during time step once stop point is reached.

stop2Bounce.desc: stop2Bounce is velocity factor for bounce back once stop point is reached.

stop2ErrorCorrection.desc: stop2ErrorCorrection is fraction of error correction performed during time step once stop point is reached.

UnlitMaterial.info: UnlitMaterial specifies surface rendering properties for associated geometry that is unaffected by scene lighting.

emissiveColor.desc: how much glowing light is emitted from this object.

emissiveTexture.desc: When applying emissiveColor for this material node, the contained texture provides Physically Based Rendering (PBR) modulation for each pixel.

emissiveTextureMapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

normalScale.desc: normalScale controls the degree to which normalTexture RGB values apply XYZ-normal bump mapping to pixels in the parent material.

normalTexture.desc: When applying normalScale for this material node, the contained texture modulates the texture across the surface.

normalTextureMapping.desc: The mapping label identifies which texture coordinates and transformations are used to compute texture effects from corresponding geometry on a given material.

Viewpoint.info: Viewpoint provides a specific location and direction where the user may view the scene.

bindTime.desc: Event sent reporting timestamp when node becomes active/inactive.

centerOfRotation.desc: centerOfRotation specifies center point about which to rotate user's eyepoint when in EXAMINE or LOOKAT mode.

description.desc: Text description or navigation hint to describe the significance of this model Viewpoint.

farDistance.desc: farDistance defines maximum clipping plane distance allowed for object display.

fieldOfView.desc: Preferred minimum viewing angle from this viewpoint in radians, providing minimum height or minimum width (whichever is smaller).

isBound.desc: Output event true gets sent when node becomes bound and activated, otherwise output event false gets sent when node becomes unbound and deactivated.

jump.desc: Transition instantly by jumping, otherwise smoothly adjust offsets in place when changing to this Viewpoint.

navigationInfo.desc: The navigationInfo field defines a dedicated NavigationInfo node for this X3DViewpointNode.

nearDistance.desc: nearDistance defines minimum clipping plane distance necessary for object display.

orientation.desc: Rotation (axis, angle in radians) of Viewpoint, relative to default -Z axis direction in local coordinate system.

position.desc: position (x, y, z in meters) relative to local coordinate system.

retainUserOffsets.desc: Retain (true) or reset to zero (false) any prior user navigation offsets from defined viewpoint position, orientation.

set_bind.desc: Sending event set_bind=true makes this node active.

viewAll.desc: Viewpoint is automatically adjusted to view all visible geometry.

center.desc: center specifies center point of proximity box within which ViewpointGroup is usable and displayed on viewpoint list.

children.desc: ViewpointGroup contains Viewpoint, OrthoViewpoint, GeoViewpoint and other ViewpointGroup nodes that each have containerField='children' default value.

description.desc: Text description or navigation hint to identify this ViewpointGroup.

displayed.desc: displayed determines whether this ViewpointGroup is displayed in the current viewpoint list.

retainUserOffsets.desc: Retain (true) or reset to zero (false) any prior user navigation offsets from defined viewpoint position, orientation.

size.desc: size of Proximity box around center location, oriented within local transformation frame, within which ViewpointGroup is usable and displayed on viewpoint list.

bboxDisplay.desc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

clipBoundary.desc: clipBoundary is specified in fractions of the normal render surface in the sequence left/right/bottom/top.

enterTime.desc: Time event generated when user's camera enters visibility region for sensor.

exitTime.desc: Time event generated when user's camera exits visibility region for sensor.

size.desc: size of visibility box around center location, oriented within local transformation frame.

bboxDisplay.desc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

bboxSize.desc: Bounding box size is usually omitted, and can easily be calculated automatically by an X3D player at scene-loading time with minimal computational cost.

dimensions.desc: Actual-size X-Y-Z dimensions of volume data in local coordinate system.

renderStyle.desc: Optional single contained X3DVolumeRenderStyleNode node that defines specific rendering technique for this volumetric object.

visible.desc: Whether or not renderable content within this node is visually displayed.

voxels.desc: Optional single contained X3DTexture3DNode (ComposedTexture3D, ImageTexture3D, PixelTexture3D) that provides raw voxel information utilized by corresponding rendering styles.

VolumeEmitter.info: VolumeEmitter emits particles from a random position confined within the given closed geometry volume.

coord.desc: Coordinates for the geometry used as the emitting volume.

coordIndex.desc: coordIndex indices are applied to contained Coordinate values in order to define randomly generated initial geometry of the particles.

direction.desc: Initial direction from which particles emanate.

mass.desc: Basic mass of each particle, defined in mass base units (default is kilograms).

on.desc: Enables/disables production of particles from this emitter node.

speed.desc: Initial linear speed (default is m/s) imparted to all particles along their direction of movement.

surfaceArea.desc: Particle surface area in area base units (default is meters squared).

variation.desc: Multiplier for the randomness used to control the range of possible output values.

VolumePickSensor.info: VolumePickSensor tests picking intersections using the pickingGeometry against the pickTarget geometry volume.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the node.

intersectionType.desc: intersectionType specifies precision of the collision computation.

isActive.desc: isActive indicates when the intersecting object is picked by the picking geometry.

objectType.desc: The objectType field specifies a set of labels used in the picking process.

pickedGeometry.desc: Output event containing the node or nodes that have been found to intersect with the picking geometry from the last time this node performed a picking operation, given in the local coordinate system.

pickingGeometry.desc: pickingGeometry specifies the exact geometry coordinates that are used to perform the intersection testing of the picking operation.

pickTarget.desc: pickTarget specifies the list of nodes against which picking operations are performed.

sortOrder.desc: The sortOrder field determines the order provided for picked output events.

WaveShaper.info: WaveShaper node represents a nonlinear distorter that applies a wave-shaping distortion curve to the signal.

channelCount.desc: channelCount reports number of channels provided by input nodes.

channelCountMode.desc: channelCountMode determines how individual channels are counted when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

channelInterpretation.desc: channelInterpretation determines how individual channels are treated when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs.

children.desc: The children field specifies audio-graph sound sources providing input signals for this node.

curve.desc: The curve field is an array of floating-point numbers describing the distortion to apply.

description.desc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of the url asset.

elapsedTime.desc: Current elapsed time since AudioClip activated/running, cumulative in seconds, and not counting any paused time.

gain.desc: The gain field is a factor that represents the amount of linear amplification to apply to the output of the node.

isActive.desc: isActive true/false events are sent when playback starts/stops.

isPaused.desc: isPaused true/false events are sent when AudioClip is paused/resumed.

oversample.desc: The oversample field is specifies what type of oversampling (if any) should be used when applying the shaping curve.

pauseTime.desc: When time now >= pauseTime, isPaused becomes true and AudioClip becomes paused.

resumeTime.desc: When resumeTime becomes <= time now, isPaused becomes false and AudioClip becomes active.

startTime.desc: Absolute time: number of seconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT.

stopTime.desc: Absolute time: number of seconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT.

tailTime.desc: tailTime is duration of time that a node continues to provide output signal after the input signal becomes silent.

WindPhysicsModel.info: WindPhysicsModel applies a wind effect to the particles.

direction.desc: direction in which wind is travelling in the form of a normalized, unit vector.

gustiness.desc: gustiness specifies how much wind speed varies from the average speed.

speed.desc: Initial linear speed (default is m/s) imparted to all particles along their direction of movement.

turbulence.desc: turbulence field specifies how much the wind acts directly in line with the direction, and how much variation is applied in directions other than the wind direction.

WorldInfo.info: WorldInfo contains a title and simple persistent metadata information about an X3D scene. This node is strictly for documentation purposes and has no effect on the visual appearance or behaviour of the world.

title.desc: title of this world, placed in window title.

component.info: Functional summary: each added component statement indicates needed scene functionality support above the given X3D profile.

level.desc: Necessary level of support for this scene, as defined in corresponding Support table for a given node's component.

name.desc: Provides name of this component, as defined in corresponding X3D Specification component Introduction.

connect.info: Functional summary: connect statements define event-routing connections between node fields defined inside a ProtoBody declaration back to corresponding ProtoInterface fields.

nodeField.desc: Name of field within this node which IS CONNECTed to the ancestor ProtoDeclare field definition.

protoField.desc: Name of parent ProtoDeclare field definition connecting to field in this node.

EXPORT.info: Functional summary: EXPORT exposes a local node for ROUTE passing of event values when the current Scene is included via Inline by a parent external world. These connections allow event values to be exchanged via ROUTE statements between a parent model and a child Inline model.

AS.desc: rename localDEF node AS a different name when exporting.

localDEF.desc: localDEF is the DEF name of the local node to be EXPORTed.

ExternProtoDeclare.info: ExternProtoDeclare refers to a ProtoDeclare node declaration provided in another file. ExternProtoDeclare interfaces are defined by field statements (and without IS/connect statements).

appinfo.desc: Application information to provide simple description usable as a tooltip, similar to XML Schema appinfo tag.

documentation.desc: Documentation url for further information, similar to XML Schema documentation tag.

field.desc: Include a field statement for each field declaration in the corresponding original ProtoDeclare.

name.desc: name of the ExternProtoDeclare (External Prototype Declaration) being referenced.

url.desc: Location and filename of ProtoDeclare source declaration of interest.

field.info: Functional summary: a field statement defines an interface attribute or node. Each field statement can contain either attribute-value or node content.

accessType.desc: Event-model semantics for field set/get capabilities.

appinfo.desc: Application information to provide simple description usable as a tooltip, similar to XML Schema appinfo tag.

children.desc: If this field definition has type SFNode or MFNode, then initialization node (or nodes) of any appropriate type may be provided as children of the field definition.

documentation.desc: Documentation url for further information, similar to XML Schema documentation tag.

name.desc: Name of this field declaration.

type.desc: Base type of this field variable.

value.desc: Provide default initialization value for this field variable (which may be re-initialized later by instantiation value of a named ProtoInstance fieldValue).

fieldValue.info: Functional summary: a fieldValue statement re-initializes the default value of a field in a ProtoInstance. Each fieldValue statement can contain either attribute-value or node content.

children.desc: If this field definition has type SFNode or MFNode, then initialization node (or nodes) of any appropriate type may be provided as children of the field definition.

name.desc: Name of the ProtoInstance field being re-initialized (corresponding to field name already defined in ProtoDeclare or ExternProtoDeclare).

value.desc: Initial value for this field, which overrides default initialization value defined in original ProtoDeclare field.

head.info: Functional summary: each X3D scene includes a head statement that can contain component, unit and meta statements.

component.desc: Add component statements to indicate necessary scene functionality above the given profile for this X3D model.

meta.desc: Add meta statements to provide metadata information about this X3D model.

unit.desc: Add unit statements to define data-conversion factors for typed values defined within a scene.

IMPORT.info: Functional summary: IMPORT provides ROUTE access to a node that has a corresponding EXPORT statement within an Inline scene. These connections allow event values to be exchanged via ROUTE statements between a parent model and a child Inline model.

AS.desc: map importedDEF name AS a new name in current scene.

importedDEF.desc: importedDEF is DEF name of the node of interest that is exported by the remote inlineDEF model.

inlineDEF.desc: inlineDEF is the DEF name of Inline node in the same scene as this IMPORT statement.

IS.info: Functional summary: the IS statement connects node fields defined inside a ProtoBody declaration back to corresponding ProtoInterface fields. IS/connect statements can be added if the parent node is within a ProtoBody and connect statements define correspondences between prototype fields and built-in node fields.

connect.desc: When inside a ProtoBody declaration and an IS statement, add a connect statement to define event-routing connections between a parent node's field to a corresponding ProtoInterface field.

meta.info: Functional summary: the meta statement provides metadata information about a scene, where name and content attributes provide attribute=value metadata pairs.

content.desc: The content attribute provides metadata information relevant to the name attribute provided.

http-equiv.desc: The http-equiv attribute provides an HTTP header for the value of the content attribute.

name.desc: Keyword name of the meta attribute, following the same naming conventions as HTML's meta tag.

scheme.desc: The scheme attribute allows authors to provide user agents more context for the correct interpretation of meta information.

ProtoBody.info: ProtoBody contains the definition nodes for new Prototype nodes.

children.desc: ProtoBody can contain nodes, statements and comments.

ProtoDeclare.info: ProtoDeclare defines new Prototype nodes. Nested ProtoDeclares and ProtoInstances are allowed by the X3D Architecture specification.

appinfo.desc: Application information to provide simple description usable as a tooltip, similar to XML Schema appinfo tag.

documentation.desc: Documentation url for further information, similar to XML Schema documentation tag.

name.desc: name of this prototype being declared.

ProtoBody.desc: Include one ProtoBody statement after the ProtoInterface statement.

ProtoInterface.desc: Include an optional ProtoInterface statement if this ProtoDeclare has field declarations.

ProtoInterface.info: ProtoInterface defines fields for new Prototype nodes.

field.desc: Include a field statement for each field declaration in this ProtoDeclare's ProtoInterface.

ROUTE.info: ROUTE connects output fields of event-producing nodes to input fields of event-consuming nodes.

fromField.desc: fromField is the field name in the source node which is originating an event.

fromNode.desc: fromNode is the DEF name of the node originating an event.

toField.desc: toField is the field name in the destination node which is receiving an event.

toNode.desc: toNode is the DEF name of the destination node receiving an event.

Scene.info: Scene is the implicit root node of the X3D scene graph.

children.desc: Scene can contain nodes, statements and comments.

unit.info: Functional summary: unit statement defines data-conversion factors for typed values defined in a scene.

category.desc: Base-unit category as defined in X3D Specification.

conversionFactor.desc: Positive double-precision factor that converts new base unit to default base unit.

name.desc: Author-defined name for this unit conversionFactor value (for example, FeetToMeters).

X3D.info: X3D is the root node for an Extensible 3D (X3D) Graphics model.

head.desc: Include a head element to contain component, unit or meta statements for this X3D model.

profile.desc: profile attribute is required and defines the player or tool support needed for this model.

Scene.desc: Include a Scene element to contain scene-graph nodes for this X3D model.

version.desc: Default is highest value matching schema and DOCTYPE in the scene.
